subject: Modernize: MSA + Order Form — output attribution & training carveouts
messages:
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: 
Date: 2026-06-20T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Modernize: MSA + Order Form — output attribution & training carveouts

Hi Laura / Olga,

Following our pre-call with HelioSoft yesterday, they sent an initial redline set for the MSA + Order Form. Two items we need legal guidance on before we respond:

1) Output attribution / productization. HelioSoft wants an explicit assignment of "output" that would let them claim ownership of model outputs used to train downstream products. They propose language that reads like an assignment for any "Customer Content"-derived outputs. That's broader than our standard non-exclusive license approach.

2) Training & feedback license carveouts. They want the option to opt-in to training but also require a telemetry clause that mandates we preserve certain data for 2 years for debugging. They are asking for a perpetual, royalty-free right to use feedback to improve models with no obligation to notify us.

Attached are the counterparty redlines (HelioSoft_redlines_20260620.pdf) and my annotated suggestions (redline_markus_v2.docx). Can you:

- Confirm whether we can accept the proposed output assignment in any form. If not, suggest concrete alternative language that preserves our ability to serve other customers and protect model-improvements IP.
- Provide a recommended position for the telemetry/evidence retention request and a compromise timeframe for retention and notice.
- If there are any compliance flags (export, PII retention, or telemetry implications) call them out.

We have a scheduled follow-up with their GC on Friday 10:00am PT. Ideally I want a short legal-approved bullet list to take into that call.

Thanks — feel free to redline in the doc and return.

—Markus
Markus Klein
Head of Sales, EMEA & Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: redline_markus_v2.docx] [Attachment: HelioSoft_redlines_20260620.pdf]

From: Sara Kim <sara.kim@heliosoft.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@heliosoft.com>, legal@heliosoft.com
Date: 2026-06-20T13:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Modernize: MSA + Order Form — output attribution & training carveouts

Markus — thanks for the note and for the call. Quick summary from our side (we'll send a marked PDF shortly):

- Our product team needs certainty for commercialization: outputs generated by the service that are derived from our inputs must be assignable to HelioSoft so we can include them in HelioSoft-branded features. We are not asking for your model weights, just the right to use outputs without future restrictions.
- Training opt-in: HelioSoft will only opt in to training if the agreement allows us to feed non-sensitive prompts and feedback back to Redwood for model improvements. We can accept a defined data-sanitization commitment on Redwood's side and have proposed telemetry retention to enable bug reproduction.
- Notice: we'll accept a short notification window (we propose 30 days) if Redwood intends to include our feedback in public model training or product releases.

We appreciate Redwood's standard IP/licensing model but the team has hard product roadmaps that make pure licensing risky for us. We're open to carveouts (e.g., output assigned only for specific "Product Features" listed on the Order Form, and not a blanket assignment), and would like to discuss a narrow productization carveout rather than a platform-wide assignment.

I'll upload our marked PDF, but wanted to get this summary in writing so you can prep with legal.

Best,
Sara
Sara Kim
Sr. Counsel, HelioSoft
[Attachment: HelioSoft_redlines_20260620.pdf]

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>, Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: 
Date: 2026-06-20T14:55:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Modernize: MSA + Order Form — output attribution & training carveouts

Markus — thanks for the materials and Sara for the summary. Quick reactions and proposed approach for Friday's call: 

1) Output: we should not agree to a blanket assignment. Assignments of output create downstream risks (sublicensing, exclusivity, and productization claims) and could undermine our model roadmap. Proposed compromise language (high level, will redline formally):
   - Customer is granted an exclusive right to use "Derivative Outputs" only for the specific Product Feature(s) listed in the Order Form Exhibit; Redwood retains all model improvements and any aggregated improvements to the service.
   - For clarity, "Derivative Outputs" = outputs that are direct transformations of "Customer Content" and do not include model weights, training algorithms, or aggregated model improvements.
   - Timebox exclusivity: Customer productization rights are non-exclusive unless a separate commercial addendum (Order Form) grants exclusivity for a defined term and territory.

2) Training & feedback license / telemetry: acceptable compromise options:
   - Opt-in training: Customer may opt-in to allow Redwood to use Customer Content and Feedback to improve models, with the option to revoke the opt-in with 30 days' notice (revocation applies to new training only).
   - Telemetry retention: Redwood will retain diagnostic telemetry for up to 180 days for debugging unless otherwise required for legal/audit reasons; sensitive fields must be redacted. For production incidents we can extend retention on a case-by-case basis with Customer approval.
   - Notification: Redwood will provide a 30-day notice before any public model training that uses Customer opt-in data; notice will include a high-level description of data categories used (no PII examples).

3) Compliance: Olga — please confirm whether 180 days retention + redaction is acceptable from a SOC2/privacy/export perspective, and flag any additional protections (KMS/HSM segregation, access controls) we should propose.

If this high-level position looks good I will draft firm redlines and a short bullet note for Markus to share in the call. Would like the redlines back to Markus by EOD so he can prep.

—Laura
Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: evidence_matrix.xlsx]

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Sara Kim <sara.kim@heliosoft.com>
Date: 2026-06-20T16:02:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Modernize: MSA + Order Form — output attribution & training carveouts

Perfect — thanks Laura. That compromise language hits the right balance. Action items for our end before Friday 10:00am PT call: 

- Laura: please send the redlined MSA + Order Form (short bullets + suggested text) by EOD so I can review.
- Olga: confirm telemetry retention and any additional compliance notes for the 180-day default.
- Me / Sales: I'll ask HelioSoft to limit the productization carveout to two named Product Features on the Order Form (we'll propose: "KnowledgeBase Export" and "Helpdesk Summaries") and confirm territory = US only initially.

I'll consolidate and share a one-page talking memo for the call. If all good, I'll include the DocuSign link in follow-up so legal can start an approvals path.

Thanks all — I'll be on the call Friday and will record outcomes in the deal.

—Markus
Markus Klein
Head of Sales, EMEA & Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
